## Description

Each constant is also in [`TweenEquations`](/reference/animation/tweenequations/), as `CUBIC_IN`, `CUBIC_OUT` and `CUBIC_IN_OUT`.

## Constant and field details

<a id="CubicTweenEquation-constant-IN"></a>

### IN

`CubicTweenEquation IN` 

Starts slowly, with a power of 3.

<a id="CubicTweenEquation-constant-OUT"></a>

### OUT

`CubicTweenEquation OUT` 

Ends slowly, with a power of 3.

<a id="CubicTweenEquation-constant-IN_OUT"></a>

### IN_OUT

`CubicTweenEquation IN_OUT` 

Starts and ends slowly, with a power of 3.
